title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2608.16477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).   This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. translated_title: Pallas：AI-RAN中LLM推理的主动式KV缓存迁移框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16477v1 公告类型：新 摘要：AI-RAN将大型语言模型（LLM）服务带到移动用户附近，但蜂窝切换可能使活动请求与其推理状态分离：用户连接到目标基站（gNB），而庞大且不断增长的键值（KV）缓存仍留在源端。在源端保留推理可维持服务连续性，但会持续增加令牌间延迟（ITL），而在目标端恢复状态可恢复服务局部性，但需要在切换后才进行KV缓存传输、重新计算或两者结合，直接延长服务中断时间（SIT）。本研究提出Pallas，一种主动式KV缓存迁移框架，在切换前在预测的目标端准备推理状态，与源端正在进行的推理和令牌传递并行进行。在准备触发时，Pallas将令牌序列划分为稳定的历史前缀和不断演化的后缀。
tldr: Pallas通过在切换前主动并行迁移KV缓存到预测目标，减少了服务中断时间并保持了服务局部性。
en_tdlr: Pallas proactively migrates KV cache to the predicted target before handover in parallel, reducing service interruption time while maintaining serving locality.
